verdict.rationale: Medusa's pricing page lists "Webhook Events" as a product feature, a first-party claim of webhook support for this commerce platform. Nothing in the pack shows how webhooks are registered, which events are emitted, how payloads are delivered or signed, or which tiers include it. missing for 10: documentation of registrable outbound HTTP webhook endpoints, event catalog/payload schema, delivery/retry/signing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
